_: The hand review of the generated data (scripts/gate_data.py build reads it).
drop: generated sentence -> why it is not in the data set.
text: generated sentence -> the same sentence with its language fixed (mostly Finnish the model got wrong).
labels: sentence (as fixed) -> answers set by hand, where the generation and the labeller disagreed or both were wrong; null leaves the question out.
heldout_*: the same for the held-out generation.
